title: Bound closed chart-3 native helper entrances
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7334, two literal chronology replays exhaust 860 productive helpers starting at chart 3. Ninety-two first lifts leave zero residual productive rank. The other 768 helpers form 477 same-upper-chart components, each with a fixed prefix boundary contact. No component supports the proposed common entrance lift.

The unique one-contact component is helper 624. Its rank-five lift could save less than 0.380712103178623 raw units if the preceding read could move to chart 117. The first conflicting write is at clock 32952, before main role 130 leaves chart 3. That role's fixed path never visits chart 117 or an equivalent span. Both exact replays find no shared cut. Changed main routing and multi-contact retiming remain open.
